# Singapore Property & Finance - Daily Brief (property + finance)
_Auto-generated 28 Nov 2026 (SGT). Source-linked. General information only; exact figures and eligibility are confirmed case by case._

## New Supply & GLS

- **URA launches two GLS sites totalling ~915 homes** - URA has put De Souza Avenue and Tanjong Rhu Close up for tender, with Tanjong Rhu Close drawing estimated bids of $1,450 to $1,550 psf ppr. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/ura-launches-two-gls-sites-and-one-is-in-a-new-rcr-enclave/)

## Resale Market Prices

- **Condo resale prices hit an all-time high in October 2026** - An estimated 987 units changed hands — down 5.9% from September and 9.1% year-on-year — yet prices still reached a record high, with increased new launch competition cited as a factor in the slower transaction volume. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/condo-resale-prices/)

- **Median resale 3-bedroom condo now costs $2.09M, up 50% over a decade** - The 3-bedder median has risen sharply over ten years while the 1-bedder median moved just over 2%, reflecting fewer prime-location units changing hands. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/resale-3-bedder-condos-sell-median/)

- **Bishan executive maisonette sells for a national HDB record of $1.699M** - A unit at Block 442 Sin Ming Court became Singapore's most expensive HDB executive flat ever sold, despite being smaller than both the previous national record-holder and the prior block record-holder. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/bishan-executive-maisonette-record-sin-ming-court/)

## Tax, Rules & Policy

- **2027 property tax rebates confirmed — lower caps than before** - HDB owner-occupiers receive a 15% rebate while private residential owner-occupiers get 10%, capped at S$100 — down sharply from the previous S$500 cap. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/2027-property-tax-rebate-singapore/)

- **Covered condo walkways no longer count towards GFA from 26 November** - A regulatory change announced at REDAS means covered linkways at condos are now excluded from gross floor area calculations, affecting both existing developments and new projects. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/why-a-covered-walkway-at-your-condo-just-got-easier-to-build/)
